remarks: NEW ON THE MARKET! MOVE-IN READY AND MOSTLY FURNISHED, THIS UPDATED TWO-STORY FARMHOUSE OFFERS THE PERFECT BLEND OF COUNTRY CHARM, MODERN UPDATES, AND AN INCREDIBLY CONVENIENT LOCATION. STEP OUTSIDE TO THE BACK DECK AND ENJOY THE PEACEFUL COUNTRY SETTING. IT'S THE PERFECT SPOT FOR MORNING COFFEE, SUMMER BARBECUES, EVENING RELAXATION, OR GATHERING WITH FRIENDS AFTER A DAY OF ADVENTURE. LOCATION IS A MAJOR HIGHLIGHT! JUST MINUTES FROM ELLICOTTVILLE, SKI RESORTS, THE STATE FOREST, SENECA ALLEGANY CASINO, AND ALLEGANY STATE PARK, YOU'LL HAVE EASY ACCESS TO SKIING, GOLF, HIKING, MOUNTAIN BIKING, FISHING, HUNTING, AND COUNTLESS OTHER YEAR-ROUND ACTIVITIES. THIS WARM AND INVITING COUNTRY HOME IS READY FOR ITS NEXT CHAPTER. BRING YOUR BELONGINGS, YOUR ADVENTURE GEAR, AND YOUR VISION—THIS ONE IS READY TO ENJOY!
